_comment: aterm FABRIC-COUNTS baseline: exact structural counts of the fabric bench's worlds on its default in-process broker, `test` profile: attach at 8 and 32 sessions with both tallies on and 100,000 records behind every session's refill watermark, 2 restarts each; ping-pong, 200 round trips back to back and 50 paced; messaging, 200 round trips, a 500-post burst and 20 paced notes, under aterm's default rate limit. SMALLER-OR-EQUAL: a count above its value here fails, and so does one past its law (lane_meta, fleet_mail and rate_limited 0; a restart's cold reads 2N - 1 at the first restart and N - 1 after), which a recording refuses to write. No ratio and no time is judged. The lane runs at the load it finds and reports it. Re-record with targo --unverified verify perf --record fabric-counts.
